tenants.notes: Flagship MCQ/descriptive practice bot, unrestricted scope. See telegram/config/bots.json for its token/bot identity. STANDING RULE, locked 2026-08-13 (Pranav): EVERY question that exists on this platform -- shared-1LAVYA-authored or faculty-sourced -- becomes part of THIS bot's pool. A faculty's own bot stays narrowly scoped to their own content_scope (unaffected by this rule); this tenant's exam_content is the one place that always gets everything, no exceptions. Provenance is tracked via `_content_owner` (exam_hub_bot.py, inferred from each source file's path -- '.../faculty/<tenant_id>/...' -> that tenant_id, everything else -> '1lavya'), never via withholding content from this pool. mcq_json is a LIST (added 2026-08-11) -- the first entry is CA Inter Advanced Accounting, auto-regenerated by telegram/tools/build_exam_bot_mcq_export.py; the second is CA Foundation Quantitative Aptitude, a separately-owned batch regenerated by telegram/tools/build_ca_foundation_quants_mcq_export.py. The 3rd and 4th (added 2026-08-12) are CA Foundation Accounting and Business Economics -- one-time ingestion via telegram/tools/ingest_ca_foundation_accounting_economics_mcqs.py from 2 raw staging folders Pranav provided (see COURSE-CATALOG.md's 'CA Foundation Accounting' entries for the full defect-fixing/normalization story). The 5th (added 2026-08-13) is CMA Foundation + Intermediate Law (1,025 MCQs, csarunchouhan's tenant). Entries 6-12 (added 2026-08-13) are CA Inter Cost and Management Accounting, one per-chapter file (Ch3 Employee Cost and Direct Expenses, Ch4 Overheads/Absorption Costing Method, Ch5 Activity Based Costing, Ch6 Cost Sheet, Ch7 Cost Accounting Systems, Ch8 Unit and Batch Costing, Ch9 Job Costing -- 700 MCQs total, sourced from govinjee@gmail.com, reviewed and verified against course_catalog before wiring, see project_log.md's 2026-08-13 entries) -- unlike the batches above, these were supplied and stay as one file per chapter rather than pre-merged into a single subject file; McqBank merges every listed file at load time regardless. descriptive_json became a LIST the same day, for the same reason -- csarunchouhan's own 47-question Companies Act descriptive bank joined the flagship's original 455. Entries 13-23 (added 2026-08-16) are CMA Final Paper 13, Corporate and Economic Laws (395 MCQs, 11 modules -- also wired into csarunchouhan's own bot, see that tenant's content_scope/exam_content). Entries 24-30 (added 2026-08-16, same batch) are 395 MCQs Pranav supplied as 'CMA Final Accounts' -- every record's OWN course/level/subject fields say CMA FOUNDATION, Paper 2 'Fundamentals of Financial and Cost Accounting', not CMA Final -- flagged back to Pranav, confirmed 2026-08-18 to genuinely be CMA Foundation (he'd misspoken) -- no data change needed, label already accurate. Entries 31-52 (added 2026-08-19) are CA Inter Audit and Ethics (11 files, all chapters, no overlap), GST (7 files, all chapters, no overlap), and Income-tax Law (4 of its chapters -- partial, not an error, just not fully supplied yet) -- 2,050 MCQs total. Two real data defects found and fixed BEFORE wiring (source files patched in place, no code touched): (1) every record's own course/level fields said 'CA Inter'/'Level 2' instead of this platform's 'CA'/'Inter' convention -- left as supplied, these would have rendered as a separate 'CA Inter' course button instead of folding into the existing CA -> Inter menu; corrected to course='CA', level='Inter' across all 2,050 records, confirmed by Pranav. (2) the Auditing and Ethics subject's 11 files disagreed on the 'year' field's type (3 files used a JSON integer, 8 used null) -- since McqBank.years() builds one combined set across a subject's files and calls sorted() on it, this exact mix (an int alongside the string 'Unknown' that null falls back to) throws TypeError, which would have crashed the Year picker for any student reaching this subject; fixed by normalizing every integer year to a string, confirmed by re-deriving the exact crash scenario before and after the fix. All entries are loaded and merged at bot startup (see exam_hub_bot.py's QuestionBank/McqBank) -- add every future subject/faculty batch here the same way, MCQ and descriptive both, per the standing rule above.
